leah: Quick note — customer reported repeated page processing + 429s when using the python sample with short leases and live token rotation. Repro in prod staging.

omar: Can you paste a tiny log snippet?

leah: ```
2025-03-12T09:14:01Z INFO auth: rotating token for acct=ac-77
2025-03-12T09:14:01Z INFO leases: released=2 reason=auth_swap
2025-03-12T09:14:01Z INFO paginator: next_cursor=cur_7
2025-03-12T09:14:01Z WARN fetch: 429 id=req-77 cur=cur_7
2025-03-12T09:14:02Z ERROR worker: duplicate page cur_7
```

leah: Root cause seems to be: SDK releases leases immediately on auth swap; multiple workers claim same cursor; sampleapp stores cursor in-memory so CAS missing.

sdk-bot: Suggestion: enable lease-stall on auth-change (jitter 300-900ms) + emit `X-RW-Page-Id` based on cursor+session.

omar: I can change sampleapp to persist cursor in sqlite with CAS and add an env flag `REDWOOD_LEASE_STALL=true`.

infra-ops: Also add metric `page.duplicate.count` and alert > 5/min for any customer.

pm-zoe: For onboarding docs: add a short rule: "If you use token refresh + leases, persist cursor and set lease_ttl >= 3s or enable lease-stall."

leah: Plan: omar -> sampleapp CAS + flag, infra -> metric+alert, sdk -> small opt-in stall behavior in next patch. I'll open GH tasks.

omar: will prototype today and link PR.

leah: thanks — keeping this thread pinned until PRs merge.
